Military-thriller register: taut disciplined capital ship flanked by tight fighter escorts in clean formation, hull colors uniform and regulation, running lights crisp, weapons-hot but weapons-holstered, coiled readiness.

Pirate-adventure register: swagger-heavy raider with scorched mismatched hull panels, three faction flags painted over one another, prize-chains hanging from weapons pylons, careening at attack angle through an asteroid gap.

Lost-ship horror register: unlit hulk drifting at wrong attitude, midship hull breached and dark, no running lights, no crew at any viewport, faint frozen vapor curling from one sealed emergency hatch, absolute dread stillness.

First-contact register: single white-hulled survey vessel holding reverently at distance from an alien craft of impossible non-repeating geometry, all active sensors dimmed, approach speed measured in meters-per-minute, profound awe-stillness.

Diplomatic-incident register: gleaming polished envoy cruiser surrounded by honor-guard escorts in mirror formation, dignitaries visible through illuminated observation decks, every hull surface immaculate, tense ceremonial stillness beneath the gloss.

Smuggler-chase register: battered blockade runner pulling violent evasive rolls through a gas-giant's lightning-band, pursuit frigates close behind, running lights killed, exhaust plumes strobing in broken amber light, frantic desperate energy.

Generation-ship arrival register: cathedral-vast colony vessel moving at glacial pace, hull plating weathered across centuries of micro-impacts, hand-welded repair patches covering original hull marks, slow ancient gravitas, a world arriving at last.

Science-expedition register: clean white research vessel orbiting a magnetar, observation domes extended, drone swarms deployed in geometric survey patterns, cool precise lighting, deliberate unhurried calm of funded curiosity.

Colony-evacuation register: desperate convoy of civilian freighters and repurposed ore-haulers packed beyond capacity, exhaust flares ragged, distant planetary explosions reflected in their hulls, overlapping distress signals, raw urgency.

Black-ops infiltration register: matte-black unmarked corvette with every emission-source suppressed, no hull markings, no running lights, moving in absolute silence against a dark nebula backdrop, predatory held-breath stillness.

Trade-convoy escort register: businesslike column of heavy-cargo haulers under paired fighter cover, hulls scuffed from a hundred routine runs, formation steady and unhurried, the workmanlike rhythm of commerce under protection.

War-weary homecoming register: battle-scarred cruiser limping toward a friendly station at reduced thrust, hull scoring fresh from recent combat, flag still flying but dented, crew visible in viewports watching home approach, quiet melancholy.

Cult-crusade register: ornate war-shrine vessel draped in kilometer-long ritual banners, hull etched with fervent scripture, formation of devoted smaller craft flanking in asymmetric devotion, slow processional momentum, fervent unsettling beauty.

Megacorp power-projection register: pristine identical warships in mathematically perfect formation, every surface branded in corporate livery, no individuality permitted anywhere, intimidating clean precision that communicates ownership of this entire sector.

Alien-empire envoy register: vast non-human vessel of unsettling asymmetric geometry moving at unhurried pace, hull surfaces shifting color slowly like cooling metal, no visible weapon ports but obvious threat, otherworldly slow-motion authority.

Prison-transport register: armored utilitarian hauler with surveillance drones orbiting its hull in overlapping patterns, no aesthetic concessions anywhere, stark utilitarian grey, joyless and deliberate, a vessel designed entirely around control.

Refugee-flotilla register: sprawling improvised convoy of mismatched vessels from a dozen different worlds, hand-painted prayers and names covering every hull, tethered together with cables, slow and exhausted, equal measures of hope and irrecoverable loss.

Bounty-hunter pursuit register: lean aggressive single-ship closing on a fleeing target across open space, hull stripped of all non-essential mass, weapons charged and visible, relentless gaining trajectory, cold professional inevitability.

Ancient-ruin discovery register: small archaeology vessel hovering motionless beside a derelict alien megastructure of incomprehensible scale, all lights directed inward at the ruin, crew visible at viewports in silent reverence, mystery overwhelming.

Civil-war fracture register: two fleets of ships bearing nearly identical hull markings but different kill-markings facing each other at standoff distance, sibling-state recognition in the geometry, tragedy in the loaded weapons, grief-heavy tension.

Salvage-operation register: scarred salvage tug wrapped in work-lights and grapple-arms working over a derelict freighter, cutting torches blooming orange against dark hull, methodical opportunism, the unglamorous commerce of disaster.

Covert-diplomatic register: two unmarked vessels meeting in the shadow of a gas giant's moon, running lights minimal, no escort, the conversation happening in tight-beam silence, the weight of secret treaties in every dark hull angle.

Plague-ship quarantine register: isolated freighter drifting inside a perimeter of quarantine buoys broadcasting red warning pulses, escort vessels maintaining safe distance, no hailing response from within, dread and pity in equal measure.

Rebellion-dawn register: ragtag fleet of converted civilian ships bearing fresh hand-stenciled rebellion markings, formations imperfect but determined, one captured gunship flying point, hope and terror radiating from every mismatched exhaust plume.
